N-L-inputs.objects: The nonnegative scalar Laplacian, smooth eigenfunction and Hessian.
N-L-inputs.domain: Closed connected smooth Riemannian manifold of explicitly stated dimension m>=2.
N-L-inputs.fixed_and_variable: Metric is fixed; h is arbitrary smooth and f is a nonzero first positive eigenfunction.
N-L-inputs.hypotheses: Closedness and connectedness are explicit; spectral existence is imported.
N-L-inputs.equations: Delta sign, eigenfunction equation, Bochner identity and Hessian trace are given.
N-L-inputs.quantifiers: Bochner holds for every smooth real h; there exists a nonzero first eigenfunction.
N-L-inputs.conclusion: A precise callable spectral and differential identity interface.
N-L-inputs.status: Imported classical results, not local complete proofs.
N-L-inputs.local_definitions: Hessian, Hilbert--Schmidt norm and trace sign are defined in the statement.

findings: Checked the sign conversion from Datar, and that tr Hess h=-Delta h. The source gives a smooth positive eigenfunction on the compact boundaryless manifold.
